deviations.what: The A4 preview's two code lines are masked (•••• ••••) where O5b prints sample characters (8F2K 9QD4 / 7HXN 3PW6)
deviations.reason: The sheet is a printed document; the screen never shows key material. A real code on screen outlives the paper in screenshots, and a sample code that reads like one could be mistaken for the person's own
deviations.authority: 04 §7.4 🔒 (sheet = one-page PDF); CLAUDE.md rule 4; ADR 2026-10-06d ruling 3

deviations.what: The preview's header reads 'RUKKA · RECOVERY SHEET' where O5b prints 'RUKKA FOLIO · RECOVERY SHEET'
deviations.reason: 'Folio' is on the forbidden-jargon list for user-facing copy; scripts/check_strings.dart fails on it. The printed page carries the same title

deviations.what: Caption reads 'One A4 page · a square to scan, and a code to type if it won't scan' where O5b says 'eight characters to type'
deviations.reason: 04 §7.4's typed fallback is Crockford Base32 of version ‖ user_id ‖ RK (49 bytes): 79 symbols + a 2-char checksum in groups of 4, not eight characters. ⚠️ SPEC: canvas c1/O5b, R2.4 and R2.4b all say 'eight characters' — the canvas copy conflicts with 04 §7.4; reported to the owner

deviations.what: The heading 'Only you can open your books' wraps to two lines and the caption sits just below the fold at 390×844
deviations.reason: The frame draws the heading at ~24 pt; the page heading role in tokens.json is 28 pt (RkType.page), which wraps at this width. Everything else in the stack matches the frame's spacing. A failed make's reason is pinned directly above 'Try again' in the action area (outside the scrolling page), so it is on screen at 390×844 and 360×800 (captures S0.5b__not_made, __not_made__android360; F1-1006d-1 asserts it). Check results (R2.4b's causes) appear under the preview and are scrolled into view
deviations.authority: design/tokens/tokens.json (type roles); ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (a canvas size maps to its type role)

deviations.what: Buttons have the theme's rounded corners where O5b draws square ones
deviations.reason: Button shape is the shared theme's (app/lib/shared/theme.dart, RkRadius), not this screen's; every screen draws it so

deviations.what: States the frame does not draw: not_made (reason pinned above Try again + Skip for now), check (Scan the sheet / Type the code instead / Make a new sheet), the in-progress line under the preview, and the Back re-entry in sign-up (opens on the 'opened' state; Print or save then asks before a new sheet voids the printed one)
deviations.reason: ADR 2026-10-06d ruling 3 requires a failed publish to show its reason and keep Skip; 04 §7.4's scan-back and regenerate need a check state. Drawn in O5b's layout; check takes R2.4's scan + 'type the code instead' pair and R2.4b's two failure causes
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-06d ruling 3 🔒; ADR 2026-10-07 ruling 1; 04 §7.4 🔒; 13 §4.3; canvas c1/R2.4, c1/R2.4b (pattern only); RUNG3B repair #1 (04 §7.4 🔒 a new sheet invalidates the old)
